summary:
I fixed 31 of the 32 round-2 shell findings and skipped 1. Node tests pass: 677/677 with `--strict --i18n` (17 new tests in `tools/tests/shell_persona_r2.test.js`). The new browser check `qa/persona_r2_shell.mjs` passes 122/122 at 1440×900, 1280×800, 1024×576, 1024×560 and iPad 834×1194 / 1194×834. These QA scripts are also green: screens_check 49, geo_check 37, base_ui_check 90, dogfight_check 44, ufopaedia_check 103, campaign_flow_check 127, persona_r1_shell 85 and ui_wave4_check 74. full_campaign finished with no errors and 0 confusing moments.

Per finding (index in r2_fixB.json):
- [0] Fixed. Quick battle at an alien base or Cydonia is now «Penumbra», not night: no night note, no flares, and HORA says «Hora determinada pela missão: Penumbra». The campaign briefing shows the same for these mission kinds.
- [1] Fixed. Medikits go to the soldiers with the most strength to spare after their base kit; if nobody can carry one, it stays on the craft floor.
- [2] Fixed. Enter now starts from a focused segment button. It also starts from the squad slider, which needed its own key handler because the global keyboard handler ignores input fields.
- [3]/[29] Fixed. «Esperar pelo dia» now waits for full day (or the hours it announced), not just the end of night.
- [4] Fixed. The «Como Jogar» tables pick a Mac variant: ⌘+clique forces the shot there, and Ctrl+clique is listed as the secondary click only on Mac.
- [5] Fixed. «Enviar equipa» says «Só N soldados contra X–Y alienígenas» and, when recruits are on the way, when they arrive. A persistent Geoscape warning appears when a base has few fit soldiers, and the Bases badge lights up.
- [6] Fixed. Buy rows show «ocupa X un. cada», Sell rows «liberta X un.», and Stores «X un. cada · Y no total». An overfull store shows a visible note at the top of Buy, and the blocked reason appears inline on the row.
- [7] Fixed. Stat abbreviations have the full name as title/aria-label, and both briefings have a one-line legend.
- [8] Fixed. The three debrief tips now use «você».
- [9] Fixed. The night message says how many flares are on board and how to use them (Equipar, then L in combat); with none, it points to the Market.
- [10] Fixed. The debrief now says the captured aliens' points count but they died without containment, and tells the player to build containment.
- [11] Fixed. Orders on the way are summed by type and arrival hour.
- [12] Fixed. With idle scientists, «Novo projeto» is the highlighted Enter button on the research-done popup. A persistent «N cientistas parados» warning with an Investigar button shows in any month (not duplicated while «Próximos passos» still asks for the first research). The monthly report adds a no-research line and a warning when the rating is within 150 points of the council threshold.
- [13] Fixed. When most deaths came from enemy fire with only bullet weapons against strongly armoured aliens (or in month 2+), the debrief tip talks about weapon technology instead of kneeling; the campaign version says what to research.
- [14] Fixed. Buy and Sell ignore a second click within 400 ms or a double-click, the quantity resets to 1 after buying, and «+10» goes to the next ten (1→10).
- [15] Fixed. Every quick battle gets a new seed unless the player typed one.
- [16] Fixed. An interceptor with no ammo shows «SEM MUNIÇÃO» and asks before launching. The rearm shortage is now a popup with «Comprar munição», which opens the Market on the right row.
- [17] Fixed. The «!» on Bases is a corner badge and the buttons are tighter, so labels are complete at 1280 px.
- [18] Fixed. While «Desligar mísseis?» is open, the help paragraph and hint are hidden. Tooltips appear only after a real pointer movement; this is in `OV.Dom.tooltip`, so it applies to every tooltip.
- [19] Fixed. Opening a new screen (briefing, base, debrief) clears old toasts.
- [20] Skipped: it needs a sim/contract change (exact patch in open_issues).
- [21] Fixed. Both debriefs scroll with ↑/↓/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End, and the list is focusable with a visible outline.
- [22] Fixed. In the Ufopaedia, with the article text focused, ↑/↓/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End scroll it and only ←/→ change article; the text and list have a cyan focus outline.
- [23] Fixed. Base tab keys stay visible at 1024 px (small, in the tab corner), tabs have aria-keyshortcuts, ←/→ on a focused tab switch tabs, and «Como Jogar» has a base keyboard table.
- [24] Fixed. Save/load buttons say which slot they act on («Gravar: Posição 2»). Options groups are named by their row title instead of internal keys, and each group is one Tab stop.
- [25] Fixed. Arrow keys in the menu keep the chosen item and the footer hint in view, and the menu is more compact on short screens.
- [26] Fixed. The build ghost tooltip no longer catches taps (a generic screens.css rule had been overriding it).
- [27] Fixed. In Ufopaedia portrait, the figure takes its real height and the text follows it.
- [28] Fixed. Soldier rows and the sort header are at least 32 px on iPad (a more specific table rule had been overriding the padding).
- [30] Fixed. The base header keeps a compact date in portrait without truncating the base name.
- [31] Fixed. «chega/chegam dentro de N h» now agrees with the number.

All screens I changed were checked visually at the required sizes.
deviations: The thresholds are UI-local constants: 6 fit soldiers in squadShort (geo_ui.js) and 150 points for the near-threshold warning (campaign_ui.js). I don't own js/data/tuning_*.js; if wanted they could become TUNE.GEO_SQUAD_SHORT and TUNE.RATING_NEAR.
The Investigar alert button has no keyboard shortcut. B opens the Bases screen but not the research picker, so a «B» hint would have been misleading; the tooltip describes the action instead.

The flare finding is fixed through the text only: the message now says how many flares are on board and how to equip and throw them. Automatic flare loadout already exists in the Equipar step (inventory_ui, night flag).
qa/ui_wave4_check.mjs: one check now accepts the missile question in place of the small-UFO tip. Hiding the tip while the question is open is the intended fix for finding 18.

The «Desligar mísseis?» question still opens in the same place; only the tooltip and the help paragraph underneath it changed. The tooltip rule is in OV.Dom.tooltip, so every tooltip in the game now waits for a real pointer movement.
open_issues: Finding 20 (save-scumming with the deterministic map seed plus the «Antes da missão» save) was skipped: it needs sim/contract changes, since the save slots are fixed in CAMPAIGN_API and G.rng belongs to the sim. Proposed patch, option A: add `OV.Campaign.reseedMap(G, salt)` in js/sim/campaign.js, which XORs the 'map' stream state with salt (`G.rng.map.s = (G.rng.map.s ^ (salt >>> 0)) >>> 0`). The UI would call it with a salt from its own 'ui' stream right after loading the preMission slot when G.difficulty === 2, keeping replays deterministic per load. Option B: add an `ironman` flag to newCampaign that disables the preMission and autoTurn slots in OV.Save.save. Either needs a DESIGN/CAMPAIGN_API decision.

Battle fixer (battle_ui/input, not mine): on Mac there is no keyboard way to force a shot. forceMods only accepts meta on Mac, and input.js drops every ⌘+key except ⌘ alone, so ⌘+Enter never arrives; the help line «Ctrl + Enter · …» (scr.howto.key.18) is wrong on Mac. Suggested fix: in battle_ui.js accept `m.ctrl && key === 'Enter'` as a forced shot on every platform (Ctrl+Enter is not the secondary click on the keyboard).

In the base Market at ≤1100 px the «+10» stepper button is hidden by an older rule (`.bsc-stepper.qty .btn:last-child`), so only − and + are available at 1024 px. I left it as is; making room would mean redesigning the row.
